The '''Watchpoint Hill''' was one of the [[Northern Snowdrift Hills]] located in the [[Clabburn Tundra]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Watchpoint Hill appears as an area on Hoth in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
